entries.en:
The beggarly bloke jumps at the chance to start up a conversation, promptly regaling you with tiresome tales of his financial woes. Just as you reach for your coinpurse to toss him a gil and move on, he mentions that the Gold Saucer is currently hosting the Make It Rain campaign, an annual festival where guests have the chance to win magnificent prizes galore. Interest piqued, you make your way to the Ruby Road Exchange to find out more from the Saucer attendant.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

L'homme désargenté que vous avez rencontré à Ul'dah vous a appris qu'un festival était actuellement organisé au Gold Saucer. L'événement a certes l'air intéressant, mais votre interlocuteur ne vous en a pas dit plus. Allez voir l'employée que ce lieu de divertissement a envoyée à l'allée du Rubis, afin qu'elle vous raconte tout ce qu'il y a à savoir.

entries.en: The Saucer attendant has barely begun her explanation of the festivities when she is interrupted by none other than the Saucer's esteemed owner, Godbert Manderville. Greeting you with all the flair one would expect from a Manderville man, he offers you a limited-edition VIP card bearing the stamp of House Manderville. His duty done, Godbert returns to the Saucer and the attendant instructs you to present your card to Ollier in Wonder Square.
entries.fr: L'employée du Gold Saucer était en train de vous parler quand Godbert Manderville est arrivé et vous a annoncé que des lots spéciaux étaient offerts pendant toute la durée du festival qui bat son plein en ce moment même dans son établissement. Il vous a d'ailleurs donné  pour que vous puissiez recevoir ces lots. Allez remettre ce carton à Ollier, il attend tous les participants au square des merveilles.

entries.en: You show your VIP card to an enthusiastic Ollier, who informs you of the myriad of spectacular prizes now within your reach─should the Spinner smile upon you, of course. With clouds of untold riches billowing on the horizon, you stride confidently into the Saucer, knowing that the time has come to make it rain.

entries.en: What's with that puzzled look? Don't tell me you've never been to the Gold Saucer! If that's the case, go and speak to that well-heeled youth over yonder─the one that looks like a foppish dandy of sorts. He'll furnish you with a ticket. Sadly for me, that's where his generosity ends.

entries.en: If you've never been to the Gold Saucer before, try speaking with that well-heeled youth over yonder─the foppish dandy who's wearing that shite-eating grin. I'm sure he'll furnish you with a ticket. If only gil were as easy to come by...
entries.fr: Ne me dis pas que tu n'es jamais allé au Gold Saucer !? Ne t'en fais pas, ça peut s'arranger. Il te suffit d'aller voir le jeune homme chanceux qui traîne dans le coin. Il te donnera peut-être un billet d'aéronef pour que tu puisses t'y rendre !
entries.ja:

その辺りにいる「羽振りのいい若者」に声をかけてみな。
たぶん、チケットをもらえるはずだからさ。

entries.en: Dearest adventurer, allow me to extend a most heartfelt and sincere welcome to the Gold Saucer! I trust you are finding the festivities to your liking? Whatever you have experienced thus far, let me assure you that the wonders have only begun.

entries.en: Ah, seeing that signet always inspires me to redouble my efforts on behalf of our distinguished guests. But pray forgive me─I have strayed quite far from the topic at hand. I am pleased to announce that the services of our campaign attendant─and a host of spectacular prizes─are now at your disposal.
